Fire Hall No. 1.description: The Calgary Fire Department headquarters from 1911 to 1973. Designated a Municipal Historic Resource in 2007 and Provincial Historic Resource in 2009.
Fire Hall No. 1.name: Fire Hall No. 1

St. Regis Hotel.description: Historic hotel built in 1913; made a municipal historic resource in 2007. Used as construction site office space for the nearby Bow building; now vacant.
St. Regis Hotel.name: St. Regis Hotel

Calgary TELUS Convention Centre South Bu.name: Calgary TELUS Convention Centre South Building

Bank of Montreal Building.description: This three-storey Beaux-Arts building opened in 1932 to replace the Bank of Montreal's former central branch in Calgary. The building was used as a bank branch until 1988, and has since been occupied by other tenants.
Bank of Montreal Building.name: Bank of Montreal Building

Hudson's Bay Company.description: The first of HBC's 'grand' department stores in Canada, opened in 1913.
Hudson's Bay Company.name: Hudson's Bay Company

Calgary TELUS Convention Centre North Bu.name: Calgary TELUS Convention Centre North Building

The Palace Theatre.description: Built in 1921; became a National Historic Site in 1996.
The Palace Theatre.name: The Palace Theatre

Grain Exchange Building.name: Grain Exchange Building
Grain Exchange Building.note: First building in Calgary with an elevator

Arts Commons.name: Arts Commons
Arts Commons.operator: Calgary Centre for the Performing Arts

Macpherson Fruit Company Building.description: Historic two-storey commercial building originally built in 1905. An Art Deco façade was added to the front in 1929. From 1968 to 2017 it was occupied by Arnold Churgin Shoes.
Macpherson Fruit Company Building.name: Macpherson Fruit Company Building

James Short School Cupola.description: Cupola from the old James Short School, which stood on the site from 1905 to 1969. The cupola was located in Prince's Island Park from 1973 to 1991, whereupon it was moved to its current location and retrofit with a clock (it didn't have one originally).
James Short School Cupola.name: James Short School Cupola
